candidates.problem: When a CSF shunt's primary lumen obstructs, the patient loses drainage and requires surgical intervention. A passive bypass that opens under pressure differential could restore drainage without clearing the obstruction.
candidates.mechanism: Passive bypass lumen in CSF shunt — when primary lumen obstructs, bypass valve opens under pressure differential, restoring drainage without clearing obstruction.
candidates.technical_effect: Restored CSF drainage when primary lumen is obstructed, without surgical intervention.
candidates.prior_art_state: SURVIVES — per CANONICAL_STATE/PORTFOLIO.json Slot 1 status_detail.patent=SURVIVES. Software baseline e428a9c (14-gate CI GREEN, capsule fdac7e40).
candidates.applicable_simulators: WORLD_A_FEBIO (fluid-structure interaction for valve opening), WORLD_D_svFSI (patient-specific vascular geometry for in-vivo context). World B (Peridynamics) NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_WORLD — no fracture involved. World C (clotFoam) NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_WORLD — no flow-driven clot formation involved.
competing_hypotheses: H0_null: Bypass valve does not open at clinically relevant pressure differentials.
H1_candidate: Passive bypass opens and restores drainage.
H2_strongest_alternative: Existing surgical intervention is sufficient; passive bypass adds failure modes (kink, fatigue, embolization) without clinical benefit.
H3_implementation_artifact: Benchtop measurement apparatus is miscalibrated, producing false-positive drainage.
H4_competing_mechanism: Active electromechanical valve (more controllable but requires power source).
load_bearing_assumptions: Pressure differential across obstructed primary lumen exceeds bypass valve crack pressure.
Bypass valve tolerates chronic CSF exposure (5-year biocompatibility).
Bypass lumen does not introduce kink or fatigue failure modes worse than the original obstruction.
Bypass valve opens reliably after long dormant period (no stiction).
required_evidence: Problem existence: documented eShunt obstruction events in clinical follow-up (currently PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_PENDING — not yet observed).
Prior art: §102/§103 cleared (SURVIVES).
Engineering: benchtop validation per V22.5 hardened pre-registration (frozen).
Calibrator: Additel 161 GP5 candidate identified, certificate not verified (PENDING).
Physical experiment: 20 prototypes + EXP-R6-01 execution (NOT STARTED).
candidates.decision_value: HIGH if problem existence confirmed; UNDETERMINED until eShunt-specific obstruction evidence from STRIDE 5-year data.
candidates.reality_gap: Problem existence UNRESOLVED (eShunt obstruction not yet observed clinically). Physical experiment not started. Calibrator certificate not verified. IFU document not bound.
candidates.promotion_state_detail: Prior-art SURVIVES, evidence infrastructure COMPLETE, protocol FROZEN, analysis FROZEN. But problem-existence gate is YELLOW (eShunt obstruction not yet observed in STRIDE 5-year data). Cannot promote to WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR until problem-existence gate is GREEN. Per audit's per-candidate-loop directive, the next experiment for C1 is the strongest-alternative attack (Article XXXII) — identify the best existing surgical intervention and prove C1 is not unnecessary.
candidates.next_action: Run strongest-alternative attack per Article XXXII. Acquire physical control chain (Additel 161 GP5 + certificate; Strata NSC + IFU). Verify calibrator certificate uncertainty over 5-40 mmHg.

candidates.problem: eShunt patients have NO continuous obstruction monitoring solution. Existing ShuntCheck is episodic and skin-surface. Continuous endovascular monitoring would detect obstruction earlier.
candidates.mechanism: Implantable differential pressure sensor for continuous eShunt obstruction detection.
candidates.technical_effect: Continuous monitoring of eShunt obstruction via endovascular differential pressure measurement.
candidates.prior_art_state: PROVISIONAL — V7 SURVIVOR. Software baseline inherited from CV-T08 V7.
candidates.applicable_simulators: WORLD_A_FEBIO (mechanical response of sensor in CSF environment), WORLD_D_svFSI (patient-specific vascular pressure waveforms for sensor signal validation). World B (Peridynamics) NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_WORLD — no fracture. World C (clotFoam) NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_WORLD — no flow-driven clot formation.
competing_hypotheses: H0_null: Differential pressure sensor cannot distinguish obstruction from posture/cough/drift.
H1_candidate: Continuous differential pressure monitoring detects obstruction via distinct temporal signature.
H2_strongest_alternative: ShuntCheck (episodic thermal flow) is sufficient; continuous monitoring adds cost without clinical benefit.
H3_implementation_artifact: Sensor drift masquerades as obstruction signal.
H4_competing_mechanism: Optical FBG sensor (different physics, less MRI risk).
load_bearing_assumptions: Obstruction has a distinct temporal signature (sustained) vs posture (transient) vs cough (brief) vs drift (monotonic).
MEMS sensor form factor fits endovascular eShunt anatomy.
Biocompatibility: 5-year CSF survival of MEMS sensor (not yet demonstrated).
Sensor signal is identifiable (V25 collinearity does NOT apply — temporal patterns provide orthogonal information).
required_evidence: Problem existence: eShunt-specific obstruction events in STRIDE 5-year follow-up (currently YELLOW — not yet observed).
Identifiability: pre-check PASSES (distinct temporal signatures).
Prior art: endovascular CSF pressure monitoring patents (NOT YET SEARCHED for V8).
Engineering: MEMS sensor form factor, biocompatibility 5yr (NOT YET DEMONSTRATED).
Buyer effect: continuous monitoring demonstrates clinical value over episodic presentation (NOT YET ESTABLISHED).
candidates.decision_value: HIGH if problem existence confirmed; KILLED if eShunt shows 0 obstruction events at 5 years (STRIDE data).
candidates.reality_gap: Problem-existence gate is YELLOW. Critical constraint: this slot MUST NOT be rescued by T5's yellow obstruction evidence — the problem-existence gate must be established INDEPENDENTLY through eShunt-specific clinical observation.
candidates.promotion_state_detail: V7 provisional survivor, but the merged-platform problem-existence gate has NOT been re-established. Per CEO directive in PORTFOLIO.json: 'full promotion requires eShunt-specific obstruction evidence from STRIDE 5-year data.' Until that data exists, C2 cannot advance. The virtual campaign may proceed (mechanism, identifiability, prior art), but the problem-existence gate is reality-blocked.
candidates.next_action: V8 — engineering (MEMS sensor form factor), biocompatibility (5yr CSF survival), prior art (endovascular CSF pressure monitoring patents), clinical pathway. Run identifiability pre-check (Jacobian rank analysis) BEFORE ML training per Article XXXV critical risk.

candidates.problem: CSF drug delivery for CNS therapies is currently limited to Ommaya reservoirs (episodic, invasive) or intrathecal pumps (bulky, expensive). A controlled retention mechanism integrated with eShunt could enable chronic CNS delivery.
candidates.mechanism: Therapeutic retention / CNS delivery via controlled mechanism (specific mechanism V8.8 frozen).
candidates.technical_effect: Chronic controlled CNS therapeutic delivery integrated with eShunt anatomy.
candidates.prior_art_state: VALIDATION_READY_FROZEN — V8.8 frozen. Software baseline inherited from CV-T03 V8.8.
candidates.applicable_simulators: WORLD_A_FEBIO (mechanics of retention mechanism), WORLD_C_clotFoam (flow + transport of therapeutic under CSF flow), WORLD_D_svFSI (patient-specific CSF flow geometry). World B (Peridynamics) NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_WORLD — no fracture.
competing_hypotheses: H0_null: Retention mechanism cannot overcome CSF turnover rate (2.88x/day — CE-003 lesson).
H1_candidate: Controlled retention mechanism sustains therapeutic concentration in CSF.
H2_strongest_alternative: Existing Ommaya reservoir / intrathecal pump is sufficient; C3 adds complexity without clinical benefit. PENDING identification per CEO directive.
H3_implementation_artifact: Benchtop concentration measurement is contaminated by sample handling.
H4_competing_mechanism: Systemic delivery with BBB-opening adjuvant (different mechanism, avoids CSF entirely).
load_bearing_assumptions: Retention mechanism does not violate CSF turnover physics (CE-003 PROVEN_INVARIANT — 2.88x/day makes membrane-based retention impossible).
Controlled mechanism (not passive membrane) can sustain concentration.
Mechanism tolerates chronic CSF exposure.
Therapeutic payload survives retention mechanism (no denaturation, no aggregation).
required_evidence: Problem existence: CNS delivery gap confirmed (existing solutions inadequate).
Prior art: §102/§103 cleared (V8.8 frozen).

Strongest-alternative attack: PENDING per CEO directive — 'must be identified before experimental spend.' Candidates: Ommaya reservoir, intrathecal pumps, CereVasc's own drug-delivery IP (US11850390B2 + US11883309B2), systemic delivery alternatives.
Engineering: V8.8 validation-ready package (frozen).
Physical experiment: not yet executed (per CEO directive, strongest-alternative attack first).
candidates.decision_value: HIGH if strongest-alternative attack survives; KILLED if strongest-alternative makes C3 unnecessary.
candidates.reality_gap: Validation-ready but NOT yet validated. Strongest-alternative attack NOT yet run. Physical experiment NOT yet executed. Per CEO directive: 'Only if Slot 3 survives the strongest-alternative attack should experimental resources be spent.'
candidates.promotion_state_detail: Validation-ready package frozen. Prior art SURVIVES. But strongest-alternative attack is PENDING — this is the explicit next gate per CEO directive. Cannot promote to WORLD_CLASS_VIRTUAL_SURVIVOR until strongest-alternative attack is GREEN. Per Article XXXII, this is mandatory before any experimental spend.
candidates.next_action: Run strongest-alternative attack. Identify best existing CNS delivery solution (Ommaya, intrathecal pump, CereVasc IP, systemic alternatives). Prove C3 is not unnecessary.

candidates.problem: Merged platform of chronic dual-pressure sensor + CSF biosensor array + ML predictive failure detection. NOT YET ESTABLISHED at the merged-platform level per CEO directive.
candidates.mechanism: Chronic dual-pressure sensor + CSF biosensor array + ML predictive failure detection, integrated as a lifecycle intelligence platform for eShunt patients.
candidates.technical_effect: Predictive failure detection + chronic biomarker monitoring + integrated lifecycle intelligence for eShunt patients.
candidates.prior_art_state: DISCOVERY_COMPLETE per individual territories (CV-T09 V1, CV-T10 V1). Merged-platform prior art NOT yet searched.
candidates.applicable_simulators: WORLD_A_FEBIO (sensor mechanics), WORLD_C_clotFoam (biosensor transport), WORLD_D_svFSI (patient-specific vascular context). World B (Peridynamics) NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_WORLD — no fracture.
competing_hypotheses: H0_null: Sensor + biosensor + ML are collinear; Jacobian rank deficiency (V25 lesson).
H1_candidate: Merged platform provides orthogonal information enabling predictive failure detection.
H2_strongest_alternative: Separate CV-T09 (biosensor) and CV-T10 (ML) platforms are sufficient; merging adds complexity without benefit.
H3_implementation_artifact: ML overfits to historical failure data; predictive performance does not generalize.
H4_competing_mechanism: External wearable monitoring (no implantable sensor needed).
load_bearing_assumptions: Sensor + biosensor + ML signals are NOT collinear (V25 lesson — Jacobian rank analysis MUST be run BEFORE ML training).
Chronic dual-pressure sensor survives 5-year CSF environment (same as C2).
Biosensor array survives CSF biofouling.
ML model generalizes across patient variability.
Merged platform enables something neither slot alone enables (NOT YET ESTABLISHED).

candidates.mechanism: FOR THE CANDIDATE BEING EVALUATED: dD/dstrain deceleration as a precursor signal predicting thrombus fragmentation, detectable ~2.5 strain before D_critical=0.9.
candidates.technical_effect: Early warning of thrombus fragmentation during thrombectomy, enabling intervention to prevent embolization.

competing_hypotheses: H0_null: No precursor signal exists; fragmentation is abrupt.
H1_candidate: dD/dstrain deceleration is a precursor signal before fragmentation.
H2_strongest_alternative: Precursor is an artifact of CDM's smooth damage accumulation; peridynamics with bond breakage would not exhibit it (load-bearing assumption A1).
H3_implementation_artifact: Precursor is a numerical artifact of element deletion in FEBio.
H4_competing_mechanism: Surface erosion under flow (not bulk damage) drives fragmentation; precursor does not survive flow (load-bearing assumption A2).
load_bearing_assumptions: A1_smooth_CDM_damage: precursor exists because CDM accumulates damage smoothly — test in Peridigm.
A2_quasi_static: precursor exists under quasi-static loading — test in clotFoam coupled with Peridgm.
A3_homogeneous: precursor exists in homogeneous clots — test in Peridgm with heterogeneous bond-failure thresholds.
A4_patient_geometry: precursor exists in idealized geometry — test in svFSI patient-specific.
A5_constitutive_equivalence: Peridgm's material model can be made equivalent to FEBio's neo-Hookean — test in cross-world comparison (P7).
